comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom develops complex digital/mixed signal CMOS and analog III-V semiconductor devices, offering thousands of products for markets including AI networking, data centers, telecommunications, and factory automation.
comparisons.comparison: AMD and Broadcom both highlight the role of their semiconductor technologies in powering data centers and artificial intelligence. AMD specifically mentions its technologies power 'data centers... and artificial intelligence (AI)', focusing on the end-use application context. Broadcom aligns with this by listing 'artificial intelligence ("AI") networking and connectivity' and 'data center servers and storage systems' as key markets for its semiconductor devices, demonstrating a shared focus on AI-infrastructure hardware, though Broadcom emphasizes the connectivity and infrastructure networking aspect more explicitly than AMD's general computing focus.

AMD positions itself as a 'high performance and adaptive computing leader' powering 'artificial intelligence (AI)'.
